title: Exact draw-state staging
scope: Two localhost Chromium processes sharing one host. 960x720 picture in 1280x720 presentation. Full native callbacks and geometry remain. CPU samples and substage timings are not GPU elapsed time; captured frames are not physical scanout or input latency.

experimentNotes.a1: Original state readers, direct uniform uploads and fixed GL calls; sparse checkpoints retained
experimentNotes.b1: Exact TEV instruction interning/structural keys and flush-scoped owned uniform versions; dynamic values preserved
experimentNotes.a2: Return to original state path via exactstate=0
experimentNotes.rejected: Generic component-by-component uniform cache and texture object pool removed after regression. Reported separately from retained candidate.
experimentNotes.oracles: Every-frame reference disables exactState, submissionOptimized, packedState and reuseImmediate. No pixel tolerance; full memory coverage and unchanged complete-state references.
